name: 92064 · Poway, CA
findings: ZIP 92064 (Poway) has 193 nonprofit organizations. 92 of them (48%) list at least one way to get involved on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 76 organizations.
Religious organizations are the largest group offering opportunities (28% of those with an identified type).
Compared with 10 similar places, ZIP 92064 (Poway) has more organizations offering opportunities per resident.

observations.title: More organizations list membership
observations.text: Per resident, more organizations in ZIP 92064 (Poway) list membership on their websites than in 10 similar places (about 1.6 times the typical level).

confidence.text: Based on 76 organizations here; 24% of all organizations here have no identified type.
